Description: Transmission of dengue from an infectious mosquito to a susceptible human, resulting in a primary infection.
Recovery from a primary dengue infection.
Transmission of dengue from an infectious mosquito to a human who has had one prior infection, resulting in a secondary infection.
Recovery from a secondary dengue infection.
Transmission of dengue from an infectious human (primary or secondary) to a susceptible mosquito.
Progression of infected mosquitoes to an infectious state after the extrinsic incubation period.

Name: β_hv
Description: Transmission rate from infectious mosquitoes to humans, related to mosquito biting rate.

Name: β_vh
Description: Transmission rate from infectious humans to susceptible mosquitoes.

Name: γ_h
Description: Recovery rate for infectious humans (inverse of infectious period).

Name: σ_v
Description: Rate of progression from exposed to infectious for mosquitoes (inverse of extrinsic incubation period).

Name: μ_h
Description: Natural mortality rate for humans, based on a mean lifespan of 67.5 years.

Name: Case fatality rate
Description: Assumed proportion of symptomatic dengue cases that result in death.

Name: Default vaccine coverage
Description: Default coverage for routine vaccination of 9-year-olds.

Name: Discount rate
Description: Discount rate for costs and health effects in economic evaluation.

Name: DALYs per symptomatic dengue case
Description: Disability-Adjusted Life Years incurred per symptomatic dengue case.

Name: DALYs per severe dengue case
Description: Disability-Adjusted Life Years incurred per severe dengue case.

Name: Cost per hospitalised case (public payer, Latin America)
Description: Cost from a public payer perspective for a hospitalised dengue case in a middle-income Latin American-like setting.
